Chapter 373: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: Disciple, Why Is Your Inner World So Big? (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 373: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: Disciple, why is your Inner World so big? (Please subscribe)

When the Sixth Stage Martial Tao Chapter was uploaded before,

the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path on the Chikun Evolution Rankings was sixth.

This was already quite impressive.

You should know that the evolutionary paths that could squeeze into the Chikun Evolution Rankings

were extremely powerful Seventh Rank Evolution Pathways, and the top three of those pathways even reached the Eighth Layer.

They were from the three evolutionary scholars born in the Chikun Star Domain.

...

For millions of years, these three Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways illuminated countless evolvers in the Chikun Star Domain.

It is unknown how many evolvers from the Chikun Star Domain were influenced by these three Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways.

Therefore,

for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path to enter sixth place in the Chikun Evolution Rankings as a Sixth Rank Evolution Path was quite surprising to many.

A Sixth Rank Evolution Path making it into the top ten domain solely reserved for top-notch Seventh Rank Evolution Paths?

And this time, with the upload of the Seventh Rank Chapter, Lin Yuan thought, the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path might reach fifth, or fourth if better.

Whether fourth or fifth, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path deserved to be called the strongest among the many Seventh Rank Evolution Pathways in the Chikun Star Domain.

However, when Lin Yuan actually saw the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, it was somewhat unexpected.

“Chikun Evolution Rankings… second.”

This was the latest judgment of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path by the Goddess of Wisdom.

Positioned second on the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

It had crowned two Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways.

“This is also…”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

He had thought that the ranking of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would rise, but he had not expected it to shoot directly to second.

Even Lin Yuan found it somewhat frightening.

Though in Lin Yuan’s heart, for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path to ascend to an Eighth Layer Evolution Pathway was not a difficult task, merely requiring orderly enlightenment,

the Goddess of Wisdom and the other two goddesses were unaware.

In the judgment of the three goddesses, the probability of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path ascending to an Eighth Layer Evolution Pathway was seventy percent.

But an Evolution Pathway that had only a seventy percent chance of Enlightenment had suppressed two other Evolution Pathways that were already at the Eighth Layer.

This was utterly inconceivable.

“What could be the reason?”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

The most important thing in the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was to pioneer an Inner World.

That is, to master the Law of World Opening.

But this method was also possessed by Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways.

And to ascend to the Eighth Layer Evolution Pathway, mastering the Law of World Opening was essential.

However, not all evolvers of the Seventh Rank Chapter could pioneer an Inner World.

“Not clear…”

Lin Yuan did not know how the three goddesses made their judgment.

But since it was so, it meant that to the three goddesses, the position of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path surpassed the ordinary Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways.

…

Chikun Prime Virtual World.

Central Plaza Area.

Numerous evolvers gathered here to chat.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

“It’s also unclear when that mysterious scholar will upload the Seventh Rank Chapter.”

“Indeed, I’m also looking forward to it. After the upload of the Seventh Rank Chapter, what rank can the Martial Path Evolutionary Path actually achieve?”

“What rank it can still reach? I bet that once the Seventh Rank Chapter is uploaded, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path will definitely reach fourth, the strongest among the many Seventh Rank Evolution Pathways in the Chikun Star Domain.”

“Right, when the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was at the Sixth Stage, it already competed against a group of top-notch Seventh Rank Evolution Pathways. When the Martial Path Evolutionary Path ascends to Seventh Rank, apart from Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways, who could possibly suppress it?”

…

Numerous evolvers and high-level citizens continued to discuss.

While some citizens questioned the timing of the upload of the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, believing that even for an evolutionary scholar, creating the present Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would not be an easy task,

all evolvers shared an almost unanimous idea.

That was, once the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path was uploaded, then the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would become the strongest Seventh Rank Evolution Pathway in the history of the Chikun Star Domain.

Of course,

many evolvers never imagined that after the upload of the Seventh Rank Chapter, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would surpass one or two Eighth Layer Evolution Pathways.

Because that was simply unrealistic.

The transition from a Seventh Rank Evolver to an Eighth Layer Evolver involved a qualitative change.

Eighth Layer Evolvers, possessing an Inner World and able to wield the power of a world with a mere gesture, could annihilate any number of Seventh Rank King Evolvers.

That was also why human civilization determined that as long as one was an Eighth Layer Evolver, they could preside over a Star Domain and become a Star Lord.

By comparison,

the gap between a Seventh Rank Evolution Pathway and an Eighth Layer Evolution Pathway was even greater.

Even the strongest Seventh Rank Evolution Pathway was still just a Seventh Rank Evolutionary Pathway, at best having a higher chance of advancing to an Eighth Layer Evolution Pathway.

To compare with or even surpass a real Eighth Layer Evolution Pathway, how could that be possible?

As the numerous evolvers debated in the Central Plaza Area when the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path would be uploaded,

buzz.

The time arrived at midnight.

The Chikun Evolution Rankings started an ‘update’.

Whoosh.

A few breaths later.

‘Update’ completed.

Many sharp-eyed evolvers noticed that the previously sixth-ranked Martial Path Evolutionary Path had now vanished.

“Hahaha, I said that the time to upload the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path must be imminent, not too far off.”

“Right, that’s an evolutionary scholar after all, creating a Seventh Rank Chapter of an Evolutionary Path, how difficult do you think that is?”

“I am sure that this scholar who created the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, even among other evolutionary scholars, is a very powerful presence…”

…

After a few comments, the evolvers immediately looked up, eager to confirm how much the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had risen this time.
